ucs.title: [LLM] LockBit pre-encryption sabotage chain: shadow-copy deletion + backup/AV service termination
ucs.description: Hunts the LockBit (LockBit 2.0/3.0/Black/Green/5.0) hallmark sequence where, minutes before encryption, the loader uses vssadmin/wmic/wbadmin/bcdedit to destroy recovery options AND taskkill/sc/net to terminate Defender, VSS, and Veeam/SQL/Exchange services from the same host. CISA AA23-075A and Mandiant/CrowdStrike (BITWISE SPIDER) profiles document this exact ordering as a LockBit signature, distinct from generic Conti/BlackCat lookalikes.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as shadow_cmd values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","wbadmin.exe","bcdedit.exe")) AND (Processes.process="*delete*shadow*" OR Processes.process="*shadowcopy*delete*" OR Processes.process="*delete*catalog*" OR Processes.process="*recoveryenabled*No*" OR Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures*") by Processes.dest Processes.process_name _time span=10m | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename dest as host shadow_cmd as shadow_cmds | join host type=inner [ | tstats summariesonly=true count values(Processes.process) as kill_cmd values(Processes.process_name) as kill_tool from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("taskkill.exe","net.exe","sc.exe","powershell.exe")) AND (Processes.process="*MsMpEng*" OR Processes.process="*WinDefend*" OR Processes.process="*Veeam*" OR Processes.process="*BackupExec*" OR Processes.process="*SQLAgent*" OR Processes.process="*MSExchange*" OR Processes.process="*VSS*" OR Processes.process="*Sophos*" OR Processes.process="*memtas*" OR Processes.process="*mepocs*") by Processes.dest _time span=10m | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename dest as host ] | eval window_minutes=round((lastTime-firstTime)/60,1) | where window_minutes <= 10 | table firstTime host user parent shadow_cmds kill_tool kill_cmd window_minutes
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMinutes = 10m;
let Recovery = DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadows")
   or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete")
   or (FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("catalog","backup","systemstatebackup"))
   or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled","bootstatuspolicy"))
| project RecoveryTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
          RecoveryTool = FileName, RecoveryCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          RecoveryParent = InitiatingProcessFileName;
let Kill = DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where (FileName =~ "taskkill.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("MsMpEng","Defender","veeam","vss","sql","backup","exchange","sophos","memtas","mepocs"))
   or (FileName =~ "net.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "stop" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("vss","SQLAgent","MSExchange","BackupExec","veeam","SamSs","memtas","mepocs"))
   or (FileName =~ "sc.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("delete","config","stop") and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("WinDefend","SQL","Veeam","BackupExec","VSS","SamSs"))
| project KillTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, KillTool = FileName, KillCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
Recovery
| join kind=inner Kill on DeviceId
| where KillTime between (RecoveryTime - WindowMinutes .. RecoveryTime + WindowMinutes)
| extend DeltaSec = datetime_diff('second', KillTime, RecoveryTime)
| project RecoveryTime, KillTime, DeltaSec, DeviceName, AccountName,
          RecoveryParent, RecoveryTool, RecoveryCmd, KillTool, KillCmd
| order by RecoveryTime desc

ucs.rationale: Generic shadow-deletion detections fire on every backup admin who runs vssadmin. The LockBit signature is the COMBINATION on the same host inside ~10 minutes: recovery destruction (vssadmin/wmic/wbadmin/bcdedit) PLUS targeted service termination against the exact service list LockBit affiliates hard-code (Veeam, BackupExec, SQLAgent, MSExchange, WinDefend, memtas, mepocs, SamSs). ucs.title: [LLM] LockBit 3.0 (Black) encryptor launch via mandatory -pass argument and proprietary flags
ucs.description: Hunts the LockBit 3.0 / LockBit Black builder-produced encryptor, which is shipped encrypted and REQUIRES a unique 32-character -pass argument plus optional LockBit-specific flags (-gdel/-gspd/-psex/-pdel/-safe/-wall/-path) to self-decrypt and execute. This argument shape is virtually unique to the LockBit Black family across all observed ransomware lineages.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.user) as user values(Processes.process_hash) as hash values(Processes.process_path) as path from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name=* AND (Processes.process="*-pass *" OR Processes.process="*-gdel*" OR Processes.process="*-gspd*" OR Processes.process="*-psex*" OR Processes.process="*-pdel*" OR Processes.process="*-safe*" OR Processes.process="*-wall*") by Processes.dest Processes.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | eval has_pass=if(match(cmdline,"(?i)\s-pass\s+\S{16,}"),1,0) | eval has_lbflag=if(match(cmdline,"(?i)\s-(gdel|gspd|psex|pdel|safe|wall|path)\b"),1,0) | eval lockbit_score=has_pass + has_lbflag | where lockbit_score >= 1 AND NOT match(parent,"(?i)(msiexec|installer|setup|7z|winrar)\.exe") AND NOT match(process_name,"(?i)(net\.exe|robocopy\.exe|rclone\.exe|7z.*\.exe)") | table firstTime dest user parent process_name path cmdline hash has_pass has_lbflag
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend HasPass = ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\s-pass\s+\S{16,}"
| extend HasLBFlag = ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\s-(gdel|gspd|psex|pdel|safe|wall|path)\b"
| where HasPass or HasLBFlag
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("msiexec.exe","setup.exe","7zG.exe","7zFM.exe","winrar.exe")
| where FileName !in~ ("net.exe","robocopy.exe","rclone.exe","7z.exe","7za.exe","openssl.exe","sqlcmd.exe")
| extend SuspectPath = FolderPath has_any ("\\Users\\Public\\","\\ProgramData\\","\\Temp\\","\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\","\\SYSVOL\\","\\NETLOGON\\")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage = FolderPath,
          ChildFile = FileName,
          ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256, HasPass, HasLBFlag, SuspectPath
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| extend HasPass = CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\s-pass\s+\S{16,}"
| extend HasLBFlag = CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\s-(gdel|gspd|psex|pdel|safe|wall|path)\b"
| where HasPass or HasLBFlag
| where ParentProcessName !endswith "\\msiexec.exe"
| where NewProcessName !endswith "\\net.exe"
     and NewProcessName !endswith "\\robocopy.exe"

     and NewProcessName !endswith "\\7z.exe"
     and NewProcessName !endswith "\\sqlcmd.exe"

| extend SuspectPath = NewProcessName has_any ("\\Users\\Public\\","\\ProgramData\\","\\Temp\\","\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\","\\SYSVOL\\","\\NETLOGON\\")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, HasPass, HasLBFlag, SuspectPath
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: LockBit 3.0 Black Encryptor Command-Line Arguments
id: 8d3f6c91-7a45-4f0c-9b1a-lockbit3black01
status: experimental
description: Detects execution of LockBit 3.0 (Black) ransomware, which is shipped as an encrypted payload requiring a 32+ char -pass argument and frequently uses LockBit-proprietary flags -gdel/-gspd/-psex/-pdel/-safe/-wall.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-075a
  - https://www.trendmicro.com/vinfo/us/security/news/ransomware-spotlight/ransomware-spotlight-lockbit
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026-06-09
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.t1027
  - attack.t1140
  - lockbit
  - lockbit3
  - bitwise-spider
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_pass:
    CommandLine|re: '(?i)\s-pass\s+\S{16,}'
  selection_flags:
    CommandLine|re: '(?i)\s-(gdel|gspd|psex|pdel|safe|wall)\b'
  filter_legit_tools:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\net.exe'
      - '\robocopy.exe'
      - '\rclone.exe'
      - '\7z.exe'
      - '\7za.exe'
      - '\openssl.exe'
      - '\sqlcmd.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
  condition: (selection_pass or selection_flags) and not filter_legit_tools
falsepositives:
  - Rare custom installers that accept a -pass flag with long values; validate the parent process, image path, and signing status.
level: critical
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:1 OR @EventID:4688) (@CommandLine:(*" -pass "* OR *" -gdel"* OR *" -gspd"* OR *" -psex"* OR *" -pdel"* OR *" -safe"* OR *" -wall"*)) -@Image:(*\\net.exe OR *\\NET.exe OR *\\robocopy.exe OR *\\Robocopy.exe OR *\\rclone.exe OR *\\RClone.exe OR *\\7z.exe OR *\\7zG.exe OR *\\openssl.exe OR *\\sqlcmd.exe OR *\\curl.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| regex("(?i)\\s-pass\\s+\\S{16,}|\\s-(gdel|gspd|psex|pdel|safe|wall)\\b", field=CommandLine)
| NOT regex("(?i)\\\\(net|robocopy|rclone|7z|7za|openssl|sqlcmd|curl|msiexec)\\.exe$", field=ImageFileName)
| HasPass := if(regex("(?i)\\s-pass\\s+\\S{16,}", field=CommandLine), then="true", else="false")
| HasLBFlag := if(regex("(?i)\\s-(gdel|gspd|psex|pdel|safe|wall)\\b", field=CommandLine), then="true", else="false")

| sort(field=_count, order=desc)
